articles.author: joyonto kumar roy
articles.description:
The string type is a primitive type that holds a text value.
let name: string = "Joyonto";
Here, the variable name can only accept string values.
With the string type, you can use text formatting, string methods (like length, toUpperCase(), etc.), and template literals.
Additionally, in TypeScript, you can define more specific and safer types using literal strings, union strings, and template literal types.
The two main ways to use the string type.
1. Declaring the type normally:
let city: string = "Dhaka";
2. Type inference (TypeScript automatically infers the type):
let country = "Bangladesh";
There are different ways to write strings.
Double Quotes:
let name: string = "Joyonto";


Single Quotes:
let message: string = 'Hello';


Backticks (Template Literals — Very Important)



let greet…
articles.title: The string type in TypeScript.

Let’s break down why document translation is uniquely hard, and how modern AI-powered tools have evolved to handle it with increasing accuracy and contextual understanding.
1. Preserving Layout and Structure
    Tables, columns, headers

Translating the text while preserving this visual structure is a massive technical hurdle, especially when the translated text expands or contracts based on language.
2. Scanned and Image-Based Content
    Misread distorted or low-resolution text
    Struggle with handwriting or overlapping graphics
A reliable translation system must integrate advanced OCR, which recognizes not just characters, but context—like paragraph boundaries and table cells.

Woke up today with wrist pain and one of those dreams that just sticks with you in the wrong way. Not sure if that's normal, but here we are documenting everything without filters.
Decided to dive into building an automation bot using Cursor. Look, Cursor is actually a solid tool, but it's definitely not perfect yet. Spent a solid 7 hours on something that absolutely refused to work. That's coding for you sometimes - you put in the time and get humbled.
